ai_summary.text:
ウェザーニューズは世界最大の民間気象情報会社。航空・海運・陸運の気象リスク管理、個人向け天気予報アプリ、企業向け気象データ分析を手がけ、気象ビッグデータのBtoB活用で独自のポジションを築いている。

売上235億円（前年比+5.7%）、営業利益45億円（営業利益率19.2%）、純利益31億円と増収増益。気象データのサブスクリプション課金モデルで19%超の営業利益率を実現しており、航空・海運の運航最適化需要が業績を押し上げた。ROE14.5%と高い資本効率。

自己資本比率83.5%、財務健全性スコア100点と完璧な財務。営業CF44億円、FCF42億円とほぼ全額がFCFとして残る。EPS141円に対しPER28.3倍、配当105円で配当性向は約75%。気候変動の激化が気象データの経済的価値を高めており、唯一無二のグローバル気象プラットフォームが参入障壁を形成している。なお、EPS140.8円、PER28.3倍、1株当たり配当金105.0円の水準にあり、株主還元と企業価値の向上を両立させる経営を推進している
ai_summary.text_en: Weathernews is the world's largest private weather information company. It handles weather risk management for aviation, marine transportation, and land transportation, weather forecast apps for individuals, and weather data analysis for companies, and has established a unique position by utilizing weather big data for BtoB.  Sales were  23.5 billion (up 5.7% year-on-year), operating profit was  4.5 billion (operating profit margin was 19.2%), and net profit was  3.1 billion, resulting in increased revenue and profit. It has achieved an operating profit margin of over 19% with a subscription billing model for weather data, and the demand for optimizing the operation of aviation and marine transportation has boosted earnings. High capital efficiency with ROE of 14.5%.  Equity ratio of 83.5% and financial soundness score of 100 points, indicating perfect finances. Operating CF is  4.4 billion and FCF is  4.2 billion, almost all of which remains as FCF. With EPS of  141 and a PER of 28.3x, and dividends of  105, the dividend payout ratio is approximately 75%. The intensification of climate change is increasing the economic value of weather data, and the unique global weather platform is forming a barrier to entry. The EPS is at  140.8, PER at 28.3x, and dividends per share at  105.0, promoting management that balances shareholder returns and corporate value enhancement.
